headline: SEA @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.48 at DET 3.63, with a projected total of 8.11. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: SEA moved +0.59 runs while DET moved +0.88, changing the projected margin by -0.29 runs. The projected total climbed +1.46, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Luis Castillo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Riley Greene, J.P. Crawford, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
